01:11:13	Gary:	正在回复 "https://eips.ether..."

What I meant is: for 7702, it's very easy to detect the authorizations and then do some validations in the mempool;

with this EIP, all the contracts can do the auths with the opcode, it's very hard to detect these operations without the execution, making the mempool validation even harder

01:12:43	Alex Forshtat:	Replying to "I don't like 7906, I..."

In defense of the TXTRACE, despite its obvious issues, it is what allows the open-ended "negative constraint" (`nothing except A, B, and C changed in this transaction`).
WIth TXDIFF the wallet needs to know where to look one way or another.
I've heard some positive feedback about being able to express "negative constraints" when talking about EIP-7906 in the past.
